audit: WEBKAS FAM SOS V2 frontend egress and Supabase endpoint review

supabase_endpoint.behavior: Client uses VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, but falls back to old production project URL if env URL is missing.
supabase_endpoint.implication: Do not update frontend endpoint until target DB, Auth, Storage, functions and smoke tests are ready; fallback could silently reconnect to old source.

observations: Notification counts poll every 120 seconds while page is visible; Realtime listeners are also subscribed.
Main chat, information, treasury-history, rank chats and private chat each have 60-second fallback polling while their section is active.
Some section polling has Realtime event listeners, creating fallback read traffic.
polling.recommendation: After migration, measure query sizes and Realtime reliability; consider longer adaptive fallback intervals and only refresh on active section/visibility. Do not disable fallback without reconnect testing.

current_controls: Signed profile photo URLs are cached in memory for about 50 minutes.
Profile photo uploads are compressed to 1024 px and quality 0.72.
profile_photos.remaining_risk: Other public/member directory loads may request many signed URLs in a batch; confirm image dimensions, browser cache behavior and list rendering before further optimization.

source_code_size.note: Large component file; not itself evidence of egress consumption.

safety: No source files changed, no production database writes, no deployment, no URL cutover.
